name: Call of the Dead Legions
body:
School necromancy (evil); Level cleric/oracle 9, sorcerer/wizard 9

CASTING

Casting Time eight hours
Components V, S, M (skull of a powerful undead creature and onyx gemstone worth at least 50,000 gp/DC 31)

EFFECT

Area ½ mile radius per level

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as call of the dead, save that it causes all corpses in an enormous area to rise as skeletons under your command.
